# MacNativeGames extraction scripts

Unmodified copies from https://github.com/ly05010419/MacNativeGames at `b75be8cfa704df3701e86130c8ced268e79d6b11`, MIT (see `LICENSE`), as vendored by TotK Recomp at `f469c5a7745502357fc1664c04e02522fe92c42a`.

| File | Upstream path |
|---|---|
| `extract_exefs.py` | `games/totk/scripts/extract_exefs.py` |
| `extract_romfs.py` | `games/totk/scripts/extract_romfs.py` |
| `extract_shared_fonts.py` | `games/totk/scripts/extract_shared_fonts.py` |

Keep these files byte-identical to upstream. KarPur calls `extract_shared_fonts.py` through `tools/extract_fonts.py`.
